name: Lanneis
source:
The manifestation of a spirit within Airy's lance, he's strict, proper, and thrives on making sarcastic jabs. He's actually a hardworking and pretty nice guy if you can tolerate him. Despite his prickliness, he cares a lot about doing his job properly and laying spirits to rest.

Passed down to almost every Holder of Airy's Power before Iris, he was constantly mishandled by people unworthy of him. He seems to have some sort of trauma with fire. 

[From [url=https://toyhou.se/812679.lanneis]official bio[/url]]
